text:
noah: Heads-up — Prospect (UnionTrust) wants an air-gapped POC. New asks: split-media delivery (multiple USBs with chunked shards), per-shipment ephemeral encryption keys, formal SBOM, HSM verification rehearsal, and a strict 6-week upgrade freeze after first install. Can SE/ops confirm what we can promise?

inge: We support chunked bundles (shard_01..shard_N) with a top-level manifest that lists shard checksums and assembly order. We can produce SHA-512 checksums if they prefer. Also can encrypt each shard with a one-time symmetric key and provide the key as a separately signed artifact.

dara: From ops: delivery profiles:
- Full sharded bundle (assembled on customer host) ~30-100GB across N media
- Minibundle shards for model deltas (quantization-aware diffs) ~0.5-8GB per shard
Lead times: full sharded build + signing ~4bd due to shard packaging; minibundle shards ~1bd. Physical courier for multi-part media adds coordination ~3-6bd.

noah: They require HSM rehearsal: they want us to demonstrate import of our verification cert into their HSM/CA and run a verification flow. Can we do a dry-run?

inge: Yes, we can run a signing/verification rehearsal. We will not export private keys. Workflow: we sign artifacts, publish detached signature files, they import our public cert into their HSM and run openssl verify. We can schedule a live handoff to demo the process. Expect PS day for rehearsal if they need engineer time onsite.

dara: Important operational notes to surface to SecOps:
- Shard assembly must run on an isolated host with adequate disk space; provide assembly script and verification step
- Re-sequencing shards or missing shard -> bundle fails integrity check
- Signer key rotation requires re-signing all active shards/artifacts (billable)
- Per-shipment ephemeral keys mean we sign the key file with our master key and they verify that detached signature

noah: Telemetry: they demand zero outbound telemetry and explicit statement that no telemetry collectors will phone home. Contracts want "no-beacon" + optional encrypted telemetry export only under customer control.

contracts-bot: Use standard no-beacon clause. Add acceptance criteria: manifest must include telemetry_disabled: true and proof of flag in active runtime config. Also include clause for offline encrypted-export workflow if customer asks.

inge: Checklist to send SecOps (6 bullets, copyable):
- Assemble shards on isolated host and verify SHA-512 checksums match manifest
- Verify detached signatures using redwood_pub.pem and openssl verify
- Validate CycloneDX SBOM against assembled artifact
- Run install dry-run in air-gapped staging node and confirm services start without network egress
- Confirm telemetry_disabled:true in runtime config and validate no outbound connections during smoke run
- Perform rollback by reassembling previous shard set and validate service recovers

dara: Sample commands for their runbook (copy-paste):

cat manifest.json | jq '.shards[] | {name, sha512}'
sha512sum -c manifest-shards.sha512  # verifies all shard files
openssl dgst -sha512 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-bundle.sig assembled-bundle.tar.gz
cyclonedx-cli verify --sbom sbom.json --artifact assembled-bundle.tar.gz
# network check: tcpdump -n -i eth0 'not (dst net 10.0.0.0/8)' | head -n 1  # expect no egress

noah: Pricing & cadence notes to include in proposal:
- One-time sharding + signing engineering fee (higher than non-sharded due to packaging complexity)
- Per-shipment courier coordination fee + insured shipping costs
- Optional monthly retainer for minibundle shard generation & verification (if they want regular deltas during freeze, it's a paid exception)
- HSM rehearsal & PS days billed separately
- Emergency hotfix SLA (48h) as an optional add-on; expedited courier fees apply

ops-bot: Created ticket POC-UT-1797 and attached sharded-bundle runbook template. Assigned to inge + dara.

noah: Great. I'll draft SecOps email with the shard assembly checklist + exact commands + pricing lines and ask them to confirm whether they want strict freeze (no exceptions) or freeze with paid emergency patch path. Closing thread after I send. :white_check_mark:
